Ivy Bryce: Hi team! Ivy here, starting today on Developer Experience. I love coffee, weekend hikes, and terrible puns. Mostly remote but will be in the SF office Wednesdays. Any advice for best coffee spots nearby? :wave:
Noel Corgi: Welcome Ivy!! The office has a really good espresso machine (token-based). For walks, try the waterfront route after lunch. Also bring your hiking socks. :coffee:
Juniper Synths: Hi and welcome! Theres a staff-run Slack channel for morning runs and coffee swaps. If you like single-origin, check the blue basket in the pantry on Thursdays.
Arlo Toast: Badge pickup at security by 9:30. We have a bike locker if you cycle. Also if you want a desk plant, theres a small potting session on Friday at noon.
Ivy Bryce: coffee swap?? count me in. I have a bag of Yirgacheffe that I will trade for cookies.
Noel Corgi: Please bring cookies. Mochi will be your biggest fan.
welcome-bot: Reminder: complete HR and IT checklists: https://redwood.example/onboard (due in 72 hours)
Juniper Synths: Quick poll: first team lunch preference  food trucks in the plaza or everyone heads to Slurp Station? react with :truck: or :ramen:
Ivy Bryce: :truck: for variety. Thanks for the warm welcome, excited to meet yall in person!
